mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a weakening housing sector that signals broader demand contraction, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline from their 3-month highs, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During supply shock regimes characterized by industrial production below 100 and year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5%, stagflationary risks increase, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 1.0% from its 6-month low, it signals monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200,000 per month signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 200,000, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.0%), a decline in residential investment (RSAFS) below its 3-month moving average signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (RSAFS < 3-month MA and GDPC1 > 2.0% annualized), or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals monetary tightening coinciding with a supply shock, increasing recession risk and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and INDPRO falls, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.02.
